001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.econ.impl;
002
003import java.util.HashMap;
004import java.util.Map;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.FactionAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.CommodityOnMarketAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.EconomyAPI.EconomyUpdateListener;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.StatBonus;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Commodities;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Stats;
014
015public class ShipQuality implements EconomyUpdateListener {
016
017        public static final String KEY = "$core_shipQualityManager";
018        
019        public static ShipQuality getInstance() {
020                Object test = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get(KEY);
021                if (test == null) {
022                        test = new ShipQuality();
023                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(KEY, test);
024                }
025                return (ShipQuality) test; 
026        }
027        
028        
029        public static class QualityData {
030                public String econGroup;
031                public FactionAPI faction;
032                public StatBonus quality = new StatBonus();
033                
034                
035                public MarketAPI market;
036                public int prod;
037                public float qMod = 0f;
038                public QualityData(String econGroup, FactionAPI faction) {
039                        this.econGroup = econGroup;
040                        this.faction = faction;
041                }
042        }
043        
044        protected transient Map<String, QualityData> data = new HashMap<String, QualityData>();
045        
046        protected Object readResolve() {
047                data = new HashMap<String, QualityData>();
048                return this;
049        }
050        
051        public ShipQuality() {
052                Global.getSector().getEconomy().addUpdateListener(this);
053        }
054        
055        public String getKey(MarketAPI market) {
056                return market.getFactionId() + "_" + market.getEconGroup();
057        }
058        
059        public void economyUpdated() {
060                // use highest in-faction export, tie-break with quality
061                // need to consider different econ groups separately CommodityMarketDataAPI
062                // even a ship production of 1 unit in-faction is enough 
063                // to get in-faction rather than imported hulls and quality
064                
065                data.clear();
066                
067                for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
068//                      if (market.getName().equals("Stral")) {
069//                              System.out.println("wefwef");
070//                      }
071                        
072                        QualityData d = getQualityData(market);
073                        
074                        CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(Commodities.SHIPS);
075                        int prod = Math.min(com.getAvailable(), com.getMaxSupply());
076//                      if (com.getCommodityMarketData() == null) {
077//                              System.out.println("wfwefew");
078//                      }
079//                      if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
080//                              System.out.println("wefwefwe");
081//                      }
082//                      if (market.getName().contains("Kapteyn")) {
083//                              System.out.println("wefwefwe");
084//                      }
085                        int inFactionShipping = com.getCommodityMarketData().getMaxShipping(market, true);
086                        prod = Math.min(prod, inFactionShipping);
087                        prod = Math.max(Math.min(com.getAvailable(), com.getMaxSupply()), prod);
088                        if (prod >= d.prod && prod > 0) {
089                                float q = market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PRODUCTION_QUALITY_MOD).computeEffective(0f);
090                                if (q >= d.qMod || prod > d.prod) {
091                                        d.prod = prod;
092                                        d.qMod = q;
093                                        d.market = market;
094                                        d.quality = market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PRODUCTION_QUALITY_MOD);
095                                }
096                        }
097                }
098        }
099        
100        public static float IMPORT_PENALTY = Global.getSettings().getFloat("qualityPenaltyForImports");
101        
102        public QualityData getQualityData(MarketAPI market) {
103                String key = getKey(market);
104                QualityData d = data.get(key);
105                if (d == null) {
106//                      if (market.getName().equals("Rosas")) {
107//                              System.out.println("wefwef");
108//                      }
109                        d = new QualityData(market.getEconGroup(), market.getFaction());
110                        if (!market.isHidden()) {
111                                d.quality.modifyFlat("no_prod_penalty", IMPORT_PENALTY, "Cross-faction imports");
112                        }
113                        //d.market = market; // doesn't matter which market, just needs to have a market to show up in tooltip
114                        d.prod = -1;
115                        d.qMod = -1;
116                        data.put(key, d);
117                }
118                return d;
119        }
120        
121        public void commodityUpdated(String commodityId) {
122                
123        }
124
125        public boolean isEconomyListenerExpired() {
126                return false;
127        }
128        
129        
130        public static float getShipQuality(MarketAPI market, String factionId) {
131                float quality = 0f;
132                
133                if (market != null) {
134                        QualityData d = getInstance().getQualityData(market);
135                        quality = d.quality.computeEffective(0f);
136                        quality += market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.FLEET_QUALITY_MOD).computeEffective(0f);
137                }
138                
139                if (factionId != null) {
140                        if (market != null && market.getFaction() != null) {
141                                quality -= market.getFaction().getDoctrine().getShipQualityContribution();
142                        }
143                        quality += Global.getSector().getFaction(factionId).getDoctrine().getShipQualityContribution();
144                }
145                
146                return quality;
147        }
148}
